# Econ Research Skills (Hanlu Long)

license: `PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 (econ-review); MIT (econ-slides, econ-write)` · 4 skills · last update: 2026-07-19

**Maintainers:** Hanlu Long (hanlulong on GitHub; also maintains awesome-ai-for-economists)

**Compatibility:** `claude-code` `codex`

> Three sibling repos by the same maintainer cataloged as one pack: the flagship econ-review referee skill (staged workflow with claim reconstruction before critique, exhaustive audit passes, per-comment verification, PDF ingestion, benchmark cases, tests, and a local "Review Desk" web viewer), the paper-to-Beamer-talk skill from https://github.com/hanlulong/econ-slides-skill (bundled themes, templates, deck/script checkers), and the econ-write paper-writing skill from https://github.com/hanlulong/econ-writing-skill (synthesizes 50+ writing guides; the review skill hands off to it for implementing edits). Young pack overall — the review and slides repos were created mid-July 2026, days before curation; the writing repo dates to Feb 2026. A fourth sibling, econ-auto-research, is a vision-statement README with no skill content and is not cataloged.
